x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first combined read-only multi-file source inspection exceeded its bounded command timeout before returning a complete inventory.
x1_execution_negatives.resolution: Repeat the inspection as smaller bounded reads; the required source and x1 schemas were then read without repository mutation.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A Windows wildcard path passed directly to ripgrep was invalid for the requested source-ledger inventory.
x1_execution_negatives.resolution: Use a repository-root search with a filename glob and then inspect the bounded results; retain the invalid invocation as an operational negative.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: A read-only hash helper named H collided with the Windows PowerShell h alias for Get-History and rejected the path argument.
x1_execution_negatives.resolution: Rename the helper Get-Sha256Hex and rerun the same read-only hashes successfully; no repository content changed during the failure.

x1_execution_negatives.observed: The first collision pass followed only incremental new_records and stopped at the base index's consolidated records array, yielding an incomplete 50-record comparison.
x1_execution_negatives.resolution: Handle both incremental new_records and the consolidated records array, re-run against 170 unique prior identifiers, and retain the schema-shape miss.

review_conclusion: All ten proposals are distinct in operative mechanism from the 170 inherited records. Shared domain nouns remain because scientific, participant, identity, authority, privacy, security, reproduction, and Stage 20 boundaries are intentionally preserved.
boundary: A collision audit supports workflow preregistration novelty only; it does not establish scientific novelty, patentability, publication priority, or empirical validity.
